name: InfluxDB 2
shortDescription: InfluxDB 2 time series database with its built-in web UI, Flux and InfluxQL queries, dashboards and tasks, set up automatically with an admin user, organization and bucket.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the password in DOCKER_INFLUXDB_INIT_PASSWORD. The operator API token is in DOCKER_INFLUXDB_INIT_ADMIN_TOKEN. Both only apply on the first start; changing them later has no effect.
